common.reference_usage: the character's identity and colours: pale skin, swept-back dark hair with silver temples, narrow dark glasses, charcoal coat, burgundy scarf. Draw this person as a tiny full-body walking sprite, not a portrait
common.style_usage: exact Stardew Valley NPC sprite sheet: 16x32 frames in a 4x4 grid, row order down/right/up/left, character about 28 px tall, big head, few colours, dark coloured outlines

walk_a.description: Stardew Valley NPC walking sprite sheet of Julian Vane, a tall lean city art critic of about fifty: 4 rows by 4 columns of 16x32 pixel frames. Row 1: walking toward the viewer (facing down). Row 2: walking right (side view). Row 3: walking away (back view). Row 4: walking left (side view). Each row is a 4-frame walk cycle. Full body: pale skin, swept-back dark hair with silver temples, narrow dark glasses, a long charcoal grey wool coat down to the knees, a burgundy scarf, dark grey trousers, black shoes, a small black notebook in one hand. Exactly the same sheet layout, character size, proportions and pixel style as the reference sheet
